newsitem.title: USA: Permanent Bancorp to buy branch office.
newsitem.headline: Permanent Bancorp to buy branch office.

text.p: Permanent Bancorp Inc, the parent of Permanent Federal Savings Bank, said Wednesday it signed a definitive agreement to assume the deposit liabilities and buy certain assets of a bank branch in Newburgh, Indiana, owned by NBD Bancorp Inc.
As of October 31, the branch had deposit liabilities of about $6.3 million, Permanent Bancorp said.
Financial terms were not announced, but the deal is expected to close in the second quarter.
Permanent Bancorp is a bank holding company.
Its shares closed down 1/8 Wednesday at 21-1/4.
